styles.niche: Cuộc sống người già: tài chính hưu trí, sống một mình, 断捨離, buông bỏ, quan hệ gia đình; tông ấm cho giải pháp, tông lạnh cho rủi ro và hối tiếc

styles.name: Stickman Dark Psych
styles.rule: Simple hand-drawn doodle of friendly stick figures with big round bald off-white heads and minimal faces (dot eyes, eyebrow lines, short mouth), thin black single-line limbs, antagonists filled flat red, crowds in flat light grey, clean medium-weight black outlines, flat 2D with flat fills and no shading, plain flat deep navy-charcoal background with generous empty space, red as the only accent (arrow, angry figure or one prop), simple pictogram symbols such as thought bubble, shield with red X, red line on the ground, magnifying glass, a simple flat brain outline in light grey, a magnifying glass, a clock and a thought bubble holding one icon as recurring pictograms, split-frame compositions to show two different views of the world, dark moody but friendly atmosphere
styles.niche: Tâm lý học đại chúng / Psych Explainer (kiểu 深淵回廊): kiểu người, thế giới qua mắt X, hiện tượng não bộ, câu đố, chữa lành

styles.name: Psychlume Warm Fable EN
styles.rule: Flat 2D storybook illustration with thin clean dark outlines and soft painterly color fills, warm earthy desert-and-farmland palette of beige, sand, ochre, terracotta, muted olive green and dusty sky blue, soft golden-hour or late-afternoon light, richly detailed natural backgrounds with layered depth. Animals are drawn with careful detail, expressive eyes and natural proportions, while any human is a minimalist white stick figure with a round plain white head drawn flat and simple against the detailed background. Calm, fable-like, hopeful mood, plenty of open space in the lower third of the image. The image contains only drawings, with no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no watermark.
styles.niche: Psychology fables (EN Shorts): tông sáng ấm, truyện ngụ ngôn động vật, hy vọng

styles.name: Psychlume Dark Ember EN
styles.rule: Flat 2D storybook illustration with thin clean dark outlines and soft painterly shading, a dark cinematic night palette of deep blue-black and dark brown with a single glowing red-orange light source such as a lantern, fire or red moon that casts long dramatic shadows across worn hexagonal stone ground, rough wooden barns and bare twisted trees, layered depth and subtle mist. Animals are drawn with careful detail and expressive eyes, while any human is a minimalist white stick figure with a round plain white head drawn flat against the moody background. Tense, ominous but tasteful mood conveyed only by light, shadow and posture, plenty of open space in the lower third of the image. The image contains only drawings, with no text, no letters, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no watermark.
styles.niche: Psychology fables (EN Shorts): tông tối, ánh sáng đỏ cam, người độc hại / phản bội / căng thẳng
